::: {#def-homoskedastic}
#### Homoskedastic model

A conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian) is **homoskedastic**
[@wikipedia_homoscedasticity_and_heteroscedasticity]
if all outcomes share one variance $\varpar$,
which does not depend on $i$:

$$\varpar_\iobs = \varpar \text{ for all } i.$$
:::
